keptOut.reason: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-UD-Q4_K_XL-00008-of-00009.gguf fails 6529-ai-cli gguf check: its tensor per_layer_token_embd.weight has ggml type 43, which llama.cpp b12110 stores as 1 byte a value, so its 196613849600 values take 196613849600 bytes, and 6144182800 bytes follow it to the end of the file. A fork of llama.cpp that gives type 43 another size wrote it. The entry deepseek-v4.1-flash-q6k-engram holds the other eight shards and the same table in Q6_K as its eighth.

unsloth's engram table of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash in Q6_K, one tensor and no model on its own. deploy/ipfs/convert/set-split.py made the eighth shard of deepseek-v4.1-flash-q6k-engram from it, and that entry's conversion names it by SHA-256.

runsToday.text: The app runs a registry entry when its engine is llama.cpp, whisper.cpp or stable-diffusion.cpp and one of its API routes serves what the entry makes: chat, embeddings, images or speech to text. The other entries are pinned on IPFS for engines and routes the app doesn't have yet: PyTorch and MLX files, and models that make speech, video, music, labels, relevance scores, 3D objects or robot actions.

memoryEstimate.text: memoryGB is the app's own fit estimate. A model fits when its files take at most 85% of the GPU memory, or of the GPU's share of a Mac's unified memory, and the rest holds the context. The memory of several GPUs counts together, and a model split across GPUs runs slower than on one. Without a GPU, the app suggests chat models of up to 5.5 GB, or half the computer's memory if that is less, and they run slowly. It is an estimate: a longer context needs more memory, and the engine has the last word.
